hadith:
Prostration During Recital of Qur'an - Narrated Ibn `Umar.:

Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) recited the Sura which contained the prostration of recitation he used to prostrate and then, we, too, would prostrate and some of us did not find a place for prostration.
message: Obeying Allah and His Messenger leads to true success, and Allah, Ar-Raqeeb, is ever-watchful of our deeds. The Prophet ﷺ prostrated when reciting verses of prostration, reminding us to respond to the Qur’an with humility and devotion.
name:
Ar Raqeeb - الرَّقِيبُ - The Watchful One

The name Ar Raqeeb signifies Allah's attribute of being ever-watchful and aware of all actions and deeds of His creation. This name emphasizes the concept of divine surveillance and accountability, illustrating that nothing escapes Allah's notice. Its origin is rooted in the Quran and Hadith, reflecting the belief that Allah observes all things with clarity and fairness.
verse:
Al-Ahzab - The Combined Forces - 33:71

He will bless your deeds for you, and forgive your sins. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, has truly achieved a great triumph.
